submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the linking word of a concrete descriptive predication: the copula ('is'/'was'/'were'), an attributive preposition ('of'), or the clause-final stop after a clause that pins a physical state, magnitude, composition, location or concrete quantity onto a specific entity ('The museum is open', 'The powerhouse of the cell is small', 'The boulder at the trailhead was enormous'), and on scalar state/magnitude predicates themselves ('open', 'enormous'). The linking word's strength is set entirely by its left context, the subject entity plus the richness of the preceding descriptive buildup, so it is blind to the predicate that follows and grows with multi-clause concrete description; it stays near zero on colour, material, taste and shape adjectives in isolation and on abstract institutional, legal, modal or code-register predications ('material breach', 'unlikely', 'critical timeout', 'void and moot'), even in identical copular frames.
